synopsis: Chapter 9 names S-TaLiRo alongside Breach and VerifAI as tools for failure-seeking search and includes them among the program’s falsification methods [f6836, f7247]. The glossary explains their purpose as searching for parameter combinations where a function fails [f16025]. Across Chapter 9 and the glossary, this family also includes Bayesian optimization, surrogate-guided search and evolutionary search; the glossary additionally lists fuzzing, reinforcement-learning adversaries and Adaptive Stress Testing [f7247, f14148]. The glossary explicitly identifies a Scenic–VerifAI integration, but the supplied facts do not establish an integration with S-TaLiRo or report S-TaLiRo-specific performance or validation results [f16025, f6836, f7247, f14148].

relations.note: Both name S-TaLiRo, Breach and VerifAI as failure-seeking or falsification tools.
The glossary restates Chapter 9’s identification of the three falsification tools.
Explains failure-seeking as searching parameter combinations where a function fails.
Expands the shared method family with fuzzing, reinforcement-learning adversaries and Adaptive Stress Testing.
Adds Scenic, its VerifAI integration, and the operational purpose of falsification tools.
